source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Document a general description of the bridge, including its location, type, and length.
3. Identify key components of the bridge such as deck, superstructure, substructure, expansion joints, bearings, etc.
4. Conduct a thorough visual inspection of each bridge component.
5. Use accurate terminology to describe defects and conditions.
6. Photographic documentation:
   - Take several high-resolution photographs
   - Label each photograph with date, time, compass orientation and bridge component depicted
   - Provide close-ups of identified defects
7. Record defects found during inspection in a tabular format as shown below:

| Component    | Location | Description of Defect                   | Severity | Photographs Attached (Yes/No) |
|--------------|----------|------------------------------------------|----------|------------------------------|
| Deck         | Span 1   | Spalling concrete, cracks, 2-inch wide  | Severe   | Yes                          |
| Superstructure| Pier 2 |
